linesZhTw: 的溫暖氣候，還真有點不習
linesZhCn: 的温暖气候，还真有点不习
linesEn: Brrr, it's freezing!
Having grown used to Lotedia's warm climate, this bitter cold is quite a shock.

linesZhTw: 『不知道我的朋友是否已經抵
達此地，照理說應該會有點
linesZhCn: 『不知道我的朋友是否已经抵
达此地，照理说应该会有点
linesEn: I wonder if my friend has already arrived here.
There ought to be some sign by now...
Hey, you can see really far from up here...
Wait, isn't that a fight breaking out over there?
Ah! Could that be...?

linesZhTw: 遇上了一點小麻煩……這些
linesZhCn: 遇上了一点小麻烦……这些
linesEn: Sekobang? You've arrived just in time. I've run into a bit of trouble...
Are these new friends of yours?

linesZhTw: 友，他們一路趕過來幫忙的
linesZhCn: 友，他们一路赶过来帮忙的
linesEn: Yes, they are kindred comrades-in-arms.
They hurried all the way here to lend a hand.

linesZhTw: 少費點工夫，叫你的朋友們
快點，趕快解決這場仗，我
linesZhCn: 少费点工夫，叫你的朋友们
快点，赶快解决这场仗，我
linesEn: Splendid. That should save me some trouble this time.
Tell your friends to hurry up and finish this fight quickly.
We still have plenty of business to attend to.
Sekobang, is this lady the friend you mentioned?

linesZhTw: 年來一直在山中隱居，鍛鍊
linesZhCn: 年来一直在山中隐居，锻炼
linesEn: Indeed. She is Sword Saint Mitty.
She has lived in seclusion in the mountains for years, honing her mastery of the blade.

linesZhTw: 皇宮禁衛團中是我的前輩，
後來好像因為醉心於劍術，
linesZhCn: 皇宫禁卫团中是我的前辈，
后来好像因为醉心于剑术，
linesEn: So it is her! Years ago, she was my senior in the Royal Imperial Guard.
Later, devoted entirely to the way of the sword...

linesZhTw: 就辭去騎士團的職務，那時
linesZhCn: 就辞去骑士团的职务，那时
linesEn: ...she resigned her commission from the knights.
Everyone was terribly grieved to see her go!
Why would such an illustrious figure appear here so suddenly?

linesZhTw: 調查一些事情。我和她在路
上結識，她得知我要回去確
linesZhCn: 调查一些事情。我和她在路
上结识，她得知我要回去确
linesEn: She appears to be investigating something on behalf of a friend.
I crossed paths with her on the road, and when she learned I was going to investigate...

linesZhTw: 認獸人的侵攻行動，就託我
linesZhCn: 认兽人的侵攻行动，就托我
linesEn: ...the beastmen's invasion, she asked me to bring her word of what I found.
Come to think of it, could she also be connected to Jonah...?

linesZhTw: 剛見面就對人發號施令，看
了就不順眼！我才不管她是
linesZhCn: 刚见面就对人发号施令，看
了就不顺眼！我才不管她是
linesEn: Give me a break! She acts like she's everybody's boss, giving orders the moment she meets us!
I couldn't care less if she's...
...some high-and-mighty Sword Saint!

linesZhTw: 啊！讓她知道我們羅特帝亞
的劍士可也不是泛泛之輩！
linesZhCn: 啊！让她知道我们罗特帝亚
的剑士可也不是泛泛之辈！
linesEn: Thor, then let's show her what we can do!
We'll prove that we swordsmen of Lotedia...
...are certainly no amateurs either!
Well said! Let's go all out today!
Charge!

linesZhTw: 賴劍技，沒有考慮到…單打
linesZhCn: 赖剑技，没有考虑到…单打
linesEn: Ah... How naive of me.
I relied too heavily on my swordcraft and forgot... one cannot fight an army alone...

linesZhTw: 關獸人的情況我已經明白了
linesZhCn: 关兽人的情况我已经明白了
linesEn: Hmph, not a bad fight, but it took far too long...
Sekobang, I now understand the situation regarding the beastmen.

linesZhTw: 島去，如果你的朋友也想湊
湊熱鬧的話，就由你帶他們
linesZhCn: 岛去，如果你的朋友也想凑
凑热闹的话，就由你带他们
linesEn: I must depart immediately for Ice Island.
If your friends wish to join in, you can lead the way.

linesZhTw: 去吧，我應該告訴過你艾斯
linesZhCn: 去吧，我应该告诉过你艾斯
linesEn: I believe I already told you the location of Ice Island.
Yes, I remember it well.

linesZhTw: 們量力而為，不要把小命送
linesZhCn: 们量力而为，不要把小命送
linesEn: The situation on Ice Island is perilous.
Tell them to know their limits and not throw their lives away.
I take my leave.
Hmph! That woman is insufferably arrogant!
*sigh* Thor, she outfought us fair and square.
What else did you expect?

linesZhTw: 『我們還是先趕到艾斯島上觀
察一下情勢，或許還有我們
linesZhCn: 『我们还是先赶到艾斯岛上观
察一下情势，或许还有我们
linesEn: We should hurry to Ice Island and assess the situation first.
Perhaps there is still some way we can assist...
That's our only option!
Thor, don't look so downcast. Let's move!
Damn it, I'm not admitting defeat!
Just you wait and see!

linesZhTw: 團隊合作的精神發揮到了極
linesZhCn: 团队合作的精神发挥到了极
linesEn: Splendidly fought, everyone!
You displayed teamwork of the highest caliber. I am genuinely impressed.
Your swordplay was magnificent as well, my lady.
It was truly an eye-opening display.

linesZhTw: 這裡來，相信都和我有著相
同的目的，現在已查明敵方
linesZhCn: 这里来，相信都和我有着相
同的目的，现在已查明敌方
linesEn: Thank you.
Now, since you came all this way, I trust we share the same objective.
It has been confirmed that the enemy forces...

linesZhTw: 部隊正集結在北方的艾斯島
上，接下來就由我帶領各位
前去，將敵人一舉殲滅。我
linesZhCn: 部队正集结在北方的艾斯岛
上，接下来就由我带领各位
前去，将敌人一举歼灭。我
linesEn: ...are gathering on Ice Island to the north.
I shall lead you there so we can wipe them out in one stroke.
I assume no one has any objections?
I object!
Th-Thor?! What's gotten into you?
If you have an objection, let's hear it.

linesZhTw: 為什麼要由妳來帶領？應該
是妳加入我們，然後嚮導我
linesZhCn: 为什么要由你来带领？应该
是你加入我们，然后向导我
linesEn: Since our combat skills carried the day, why should you be leading us?
If anything, you should join our ranks and guide us...

linesZhTw: 們到艾斯島去才對，不是嗎
linesZhCn: 们到艾斯岛去才对，不是吗
linesEn: ...to Ice Island. Isn't that how it should be?

linesZhTw: 劍士中的前輩，你也多少敬
linesZhCn: 剑士中的前辈，你也多少敬
linesEn: Thor, Lady Mitty is a senior master among swordsmen.
Show a little respect for your elders, won't you...?

linesZhTw: 算高手，我從小就這麼認為
linesZhCn: 算高手，我从小就这么认为
linesEn: Hmph, I don't care!
True masters are defined by how they fight. That's what I've believed since I was a kid.

linesZhTw: 就有如此的膽識和武藝，我
linesZhCn: 就有如此的胆识和武艺，我
linesEn: Heh heh... Young man, you have both nerve and skill for one so young. I like that.
Very well. I've wandered alone for years...

linesZhTw: 過了這麼多年，也好久沒有
嘗過被人帶領的滋味了，我
就加入你們吧！劍聖密蒂，
linesZhCn: 过了这么多年，也好久没有
尝过被人带领的滋味了，我
就加入你们吧！剑圣密蒂，
linesEn: ...and it has been a long time since I felt what it's like to follow another's lead.
I shall join you!
I am Sword Saint Mitty.
I look forward to fighting alongside you all.

linesZhTw: 美貌而又驕傲的劍聖密蒂，
居然就這樣折服在索爾的氣
linesZhCn: 美貌而又骄傲的剑圣密蒂，
居然就这样折服在索尔的气
linesEn: I can scarcely believe my eyes...
The proud, beautiful Sword Saint Mitty, who holds herself in such high esteem...
...has actually yielded to Thor's commanding presence!

linesZhTw: 是索爾，光這一點我就比不
linesZhCn: 是索尔，光这一点我就比不
linesEn: Such is the aura of a true king!
That's Thor for you. In that regard, I could never match him.

linesZhTw: 帶領我們到艾斯島去吧！』
linesZhCn: 带领我们到艾斯岛去吧！』
linesEn: Well then, Lady Mitty, please lead the way to Ice Island!

linesZhTw: 我時閣下兩個字就可以不必
linesZhCn: 我时阁下两个字就可以不必
linesEn: Since I have joined your company, there's no need for formal titles like 'my lady'.
Isn't that right, Thor?
Hmph! I... I don't care about stuff like that!
Let's just get moving!
